# S-04 — Fastify long-term support policy (fixture reading note)
accessed: 2026-09-18 · tier: T3 (vendor documentation) · depth: full

## Findings
- Each Fastify major receives security fixes for 6 months after the next major ships; the
  policy is aligned with Node.js active/maintenance LTS windows.
- Licence: MIT (repository LICENSE, SPDX-listed).

## Limitations
- Vendor voice; the window is shorter than Django's explicit 3-year LTS lines (see S-10).

## Verbatim quotes
- "supported for 6 months after the release of the next major version"
